database_acceptance: Network-disabled PostgreSQL 16 disposable migration 647 replay. Actual-login assertions cover PUBLIC table-grant removal, read/write/sequence denial, exact function ACL, forced RLS, lease fencing, retry/dead-letter, bounded expiry recovery, and rollback.

arm64_database_acceptance.scope: Docker ARM64/QEMU software portability only; no physical Raspberry Pi, power-loss, endurance, or sustained-load acceptance.
